workload.timers: perf_counter_ns; producer sampled_at/completed_at wall duration separately
workload.target: baseline only; no optimized comparison or end-to-end input target

operation_refusals.reason: modal is not owned by this operation runner

first_attempt.controller_correction: readiness now waits for UI-thread callback 2seconds after registration; producer/request timeout and canonical code unchanged

scope_limits: Baseline only, no optimized variant or speedup claim
No state-change-to-correct-OS-input, full-task accuracy, goodput, coverage, production input, real harness/model, installed-current or E2E measurement
Profile is a separate instrumented 20-call loop and not used as benchmark latency
Measurements include monitor wrapper perf_counter calls and in-memory timing append; first cardinality collection occurs in warmup
Capture-stage ends before Observation creation; provider stage includes Observation construction and canonical provider; total includes capture+Observation+provider+compiler
Per-sample unknown-fact/correctness checks occur after timed path; six operation refusals checked outside timed path
Source collector profile stats record20primitive/21total collect_snapshot calls; raw profiler counts retained, not normalized
The five batches share one owned Blender/Xvfb session and warm state; power/thermal/competing workloads are uncontrolled
Wall producer elapsed is reported separately; perf_counter_ns is the latency clock
No retries of measured requests; first readiness failure retained as FAIL without fabricated timing
